briefings.title: How To Build The Future: Eric Glyman, Co-CEO of Ramp
briefings.tldr: Ramp has scaled to a $60 billion valuation and over $2 billion in annual revenue by aligning its business model with customer savings, and is now using internal AI harnesses like Glass and Inspect to turn every employee into a "100x" operator—driving >25% faster growth and 7,000 non-engineer pull requests in Q2 alone.

briefings.title: Ramp founder Eric Glyman on the many ways AI is changing corporate spending
briefings.tldr: Ramp has scaled to over $1 billion in revenue in just seven years by evolving from a corporate card provider into a comprehensive finance automation platform that leverages AI agents to "sell time," automating complex tasks like expense auditing and procurement with 99% accuracy.
